title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 22: Embers

scenes.say: Not every day is a victory. He wants you to know that.
scenes.visual: a man sitting in a dark car in a parking lot, rain on the windshield, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Some anniversaries still knock him down.
scenes.visual: a calendar with one date circled in black, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Some mornings the old anger shows up uninvited.
scenes.visual: a clenched fist resting on a kitchen counter at dawn, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Healing isn't a straight line. It's a fire you keep tending.
scenes.visual: embers glowing in a fire pit at night, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He calls his battle buddy. He calls his counselor. He calls his mother.
scenes.visual: a phone in hand with a short list of names, close up, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He goes to the gym and leaves it on the floor.
scenes.visual: a man hitting a heavy bag in an empty gym, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He reads the letter from his mother he kept in his vest.
scenes.visual: a worn folded letter being opened, close up, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Pray, baby. Even when you don't feel it.
scenes.visual: a man's head bowed over a letter, soft window light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Strength isn't never falling. It's knowing how to get up.
scenes.visual: a hand reaching down to help another hand up, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The embers are still warm. And that's how the fire keeps going.
scenes.visual: a small flame rising from embers, sparks floating up, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Twenty Three. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: morning sun hitting a wet street after rain, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 22 of 25: Embers. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
